package.name: ranger_mini_v3_description
package.description: Ranger Mini 3.0 swerve-drive base URDF (links, joints, meshes). Adapted for ROS 2 from AgileX's upstream ROS 1 package (agilexrobotics/ugv_gazebo_sim, ranger_mini/ranger_mini_v3): wrapped as an xacro macro (xacro:ranger_mini_v3, params="prefix") and repointed mesh package:// URIs, since upstream is a flat non-parameterized catkin package with no ROS 2 / xacro-macro support. Geometry, inertials, and joint limits are unchanged from upstream. See urdf/ranger_mini_v3.xacro for the full adaptation notes. Consumed by ranger_xarm6_description's ranger_xarm6.urdf.xacro.
